title: 薄荷冒险者 · 起跳过渡 v2

frames.pose: Jump preparation: both knees bend slightly, pelvis lowers by12px, boots remain planted y485, same facing/scale. Arms poised near chest.
Takeoff extension inbetween: rise from crouch, partly straight knees, boots near y470, head near y65. No baked root jump height.

Airborne POSE ONLY: body/head/pelvis location stays at the idle reference height, both knees bend and both boots tuck up off ground to y430. Game/preview provides root translation separately. Do not bake whole-body jump height, no grounded foot, no shadow.
Landing absorb: both boots planted at original spots y485, knees softly bent and pelvis lower by6px, near arm slightly forward to balance. Same facing/scale; returns to idle next.
